prompt: In this anime style illustration, a vibrant rooftop party unfolds under a starry sky. On the left, a woman in a blue dress stands holding a champagne flute, her hair blowing gently in the wind. Next to her, a man in a tuxedo leans casually against the railing, looking out at the city lights. In the center, a girl with pink twin-tails sits on a cooler, laughing as she points at a floating balloon shaped like a cat. Beside her, a boy in a green hoodie reaches out, handing her a slice of pizza from a cardboard box. To the right, an older man in a grey suit adjusts his glasses while observing the scene. Near him, a small brown dog wags its tail excitedly, sitting on a folded blanket. Behind the group, a large speaker pulses with bass, positioned next to a stack of empty soda cans. Above them, string lights crisscross the space, illuminating the faces below. A black cat perches on the edge of a vent, watching the dog with narrowed eyes. In the background, a distant helicopter hovers silently, its searchlight sweeping across the horizon. There is no rain falling from the sky. There is no visible smoke from cigarettes or grills. The woman in the blue dress smiles warmly at the man in the tuxedo. The boy in the green hoodie looks directly at the girl with pink twin-tails. The small brown dog stares intently at the black cat. The older man in the grey suit glances toward the distant helicopter. The scene captures a moment of youthful energy and urban nightlife, rendered with sharp lines and vivid colors typical of modern animation.
